notes.title: House Party 1.4.2.13206 QOL & Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
[p][b]House Party Patch 1.4.2.13206[/b] is here!  [/p][p]
We know you're chomping at the bit for more Office Party info! It's coming soon! In the meantime, this is a small House Party update...  This update consists of some improvements and bug fixes.[/p][h3]
Rate Designs More Easily[/h3][p]
Probably the coolest part of this update is the new ability to rate and report designs directly from the customizer page. You no longer have to browse designs and search for the downloaded design in question again, in order to be able to rate or report it!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/152eeb0d320ec5298e855de5f36fc81e0db61ad6.png"][/img][/p][h3]External Browser Login[/h3][p]
There's now an external browser login option for the custom stories browser and design sharing tools.  This may not be an upgrade for everyone, but players using Crossover to play House Party on a Mac can't use the embedded login.  We're hoping this might help them!  

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/1fb7c72c80e5745591110926e1f67eccccd98bca.png"][/img][/p][h3]Story Updates Now Come with Game Patches[/h3][p]
Another notable change is that stories are no longer downloaded from the Eek server on game start. They will be updated through small patches now. This is also not a huge change, but not having to download on every game start will help (technically all players, but especially) players with slower internet connections get back in the game quicker!

We fixed a few more bugs and you can see them all here:
[url="https://housepartygame.com/release-notes"]https://housepartygame.com/release-notes[/url][b]


Don't forget to wishlist [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/"]Office Party[/url]![/b][/p][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/ed5a767e1ec85a02d071920e3ba664e911ac16cf.jpg"][/img][/p]

notes.title: House Party 1.4.1 Release
notes.notes:
[b]House Party 1.4.1[/b] is here! Apply clothing option changes to saved games!  Expanded Supporter Pack and base House Party game clothing options!  Chinese, French, and Russian Supporter Pack translations!

Before we tell you more about the update, if you haven't noticed, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]The Supporter Pack[/url] has a trailer now! 

[previewyoutube=26wV-SHMTAA;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Expanded Supporter Pack Clothing Options![/h3]

Speaking of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]The Supporter Pack[/url], with this update, the redesigned outfits in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]The Supporter Pack[/url] are now available to all customizable characters.  Initially, these items were available for only a few characters.  That means Ashley and Vickie's redesigned OG outfits are available to all customizable female characters, and Derek and Patrick's redesigned OG outfits are available to all male characters!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/80fe5ed73a495fb501b3cae38c167d179d55fe99.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/22cd9ef1a9d5e3245fac41191193a4b19320490e.png[/img]

[h3]New Base Game Clothing Options![/h3]

While making those redesigned outfits available for all characters in [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]The Supporter Pack[/url], we also made the OG versions of the outfits available to all characters in the base game!  That means Ashley and Vickie's OG outfits are available to all customizable female characters, and Derek and Patrick's OG outfits are available to all male characters -- in the base game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/86aad5fa1b768bc580ea755f6bd07ae2c095ab6d.png[/img]

[h3]Apply Clothing Option Changes To Saved Games![/h3]

This update also adds a checkmark (checked by default) to the Load Game window that allows players to apply their clothing option changes selected in the customizer, when loading saved games!  We've seen a lot of requests for this and we understand why.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/f7605b1cda8ea46ec0ce4755b88d7fe6e8207b2a.png[/img]
There are some caveats and situations to consider..

First of all, it might get weird... For example, if Derek was wearing the sundress in your save, he might be wearing just a shirt from your newly applied design. To prevent story issues, the clothing is applied in a similar way to the clothing that the characters were wearing in the save. That's why if Derek had no pants on, he will still have no pants on. Another example, if Stephanie had her default dress on in your save, she won't be bottomless. She will be clothed in both a top and a bottom (assuming that's what is in your new design), since a dress basically counts as both a top and a bottom. Also, if characters change their clothing in the story, it will change out what you put on them. You could save the game and load again in some cases though and switch them back! You may find some other quirks - hopefully some hilarious ones!

P.S. In case it's not obvious, if you want to continue your game, or load your saved game using the clothing options that you saved the game with, you will need to uncheck the box.

[h3]Some Supporter Pack Translations Updates[/h3]
1.4.1 also includes Chinese, French, and Russian translations for the Supporter Pack!

[h3]A Few Quality Of Life Updates[/h3]

We've got a new character picker in the customizer for you now.  You no longer have to load one character after another to get to the one you want to edit.  You can now just click on their avatar.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/842e3e1e069431d010127abc119e44fe303aedab.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/9724a41cfdbaef103bc23aaf48e78bd644f4f9df.png[/img]
When a group preset is active and the player selects a different character design, or adds a new character design, the player is now prompted with a popup asking if they would like to add their design to the currently active group preset.

And more bug fixes!  You can see them all in the [url=https://housepartygame.com/release-notes/]full release notes[/url].

[h3][b]Don't forget to wishlist [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]Office Party[/url]![/b][/h3]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/ed5a767e1ec85a02d071920e3ba664e911ac16cf.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: House Party 1.4 Release
notes.notes:
Introducing [b]House Party 1.4[/b]. With it comes improved customizer support, enhanced performance and more. It's about to get a lot BRIGHTER up in here. 

Before we dive into that, we've got some House Party DLC coming out TODAY. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/eccfeb312efe68d3b06b2ee0cd4a516786ea8b4e.png[/img]

[h3][b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]Welcome to the House Party - Supporter Pack![/url][/b][/h3]

For those that want to keep the party going, we're introducing the House Party - Supporter Pack! New content, clothes, cutscenes, chatters, and more. There's even an artbook for you nostalgic party peeps. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]The Supporter Pack DLC[/url] includes TWO story arcs. First, help Derek impress his new boss (who be Mr. D?), then delve further into Ashley/Madison's sibling rivalry. 

Oh, by the way, one of these stories is a tie-in to our upcoming sequel, Office Party. It's a prelude, baby!

Here's a taste of some of the outfits included in the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3487780/House_Party__Supporter_Pack/]Supporter DLC[/url]. Many more await.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/7794465ffb4dda6a8a5c5da74c83509926399ac0.png[/img]

[h3]Time for a Glow Up - Emissive Texture Support has arrived[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/95d69dc671f2fb243b35c2332820a769e4f3f2ab.jpg[/img]

With update 1.4, we're adding Emissive Texture support for our modding community. It's time to crack open some glowsticks, smear the (totally safe and definitely non-toxic) goo all over your virtual bods, and light this party UP.

Emissive Textures let parts of your character models appear to glow. It's perfect for making that neon rave queen you've always dreamed of, or the fiery hellspawn demoness from your nightmares. Get weird with it, dudes and dudettes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/c46f2fdbc58500f8f949e817ff3c34edc4611a2a.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/eb140c41a2028f9f8f51245841425152202c7c05.jpg[/img]

If you're interested in learning more, our very own Zigga's made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/houseparty/mods/53]a tutorial[/url] on Nexus Mods, as well as a [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/houseparty/mods/56]starter rave girl design[/url]. 

Tons of other fixes and improvements are coming along for the ride. Full release notes below. 

[b] Release Notes 1.4.0.13085[/b]

[list]

   [*] Supporter Pack Pre-Release Patch!
   [*] Added emissive texture support for custom skin modding.
   [*] Improved skin shader performance.
   [*] When changing to a new top that is a dress, the customizer will attempt to change back to your previously selected bottom, when then switching back to another top that is not a dress.
   [*] Fixed an issue that would cause skin to get discolored in some places when changing tint.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused some hairstyles to not show up in the mirror.
   [*] Fixed an issue that caused players to only be able to share 21 designs with the in game design sharing tool.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused the player character’s hair shadow to be missing.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused _ and : to not count as special characters when registering for an Eek! Account.
    [*] Fixed a bug that caused the Design Sharing pop-up to get stuck after a failed upload.
    [*] Fixed missing kitchen colliders.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused Amala’s BGC when she’s at the gate to be heard all over the house.
    [*] Fixed game not unpausing after pressing done on the audio settings pop-up.
    [*] Fixed the head shadow issue with the player’s head in intro cutscene.
    [*] Fixed some null ref issues.
    [*] Fixed some customizer issues that caused items to go back on sometimes.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused a bra to be hidden in the customizer when changing from to a top that hides the bra, and then back to a top that does not.
    [*] Fixed part of the succubus accessories not being able to change color.
    [*] Fixed an issue that caused the towels not to be grabbable.
    [*] Fixed sporty bra being disabled under tops that can show a bra.
    [*] Fixed an issue that sometimes caused the game to crash if a DLC was missing.
[/list]

notes.title: Wishlist Office Party Now!
notes.notes:
So far, 2024 has been one wild ride for HOUSE PARTY. We set out to give you the power to throw the party of your filthy, chaotic dreams. We've rolled some of the fruits of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]OFFICE PARTY[/url] labors into House Party -- we upgraded the graphics to Unity's HDRP and added character customization and character design sharing!  The party is now officially [b]your[/b] playground. Go ahead, make it as classy or trashy as you like—we don’t judge.

[b] Speaking of design sharing... the Community has shared almost 3000 designs and there have been over 300,000 unique downloads! [/b]

And guess what? The party ain't over. 

[b][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]OFFICE PARTY[/url] is coming![/b] We’ve been sweating our man-cannons off working on HP's sequel, and trust us, this one's going to get even wilder. Weirder. Bigger. Steamier. Raunchier. PARTY-IER. 

Now, there's still plenty of work to do. 

But you can now [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]wishlist[/url] [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]OFFICE PARTY[/url] on its official store [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]page[/url]!  The [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3154460]Communty Discussions[/url] are open too! Got questions? Ask 'em there. Wanna start a discussion so you can get in a fight with a stranger on the internet? Do it there. Most importantly: don't forget to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3154460/Office_Party/]wishlist[/url] OP like it's the [b]hottest thing in the office[/b].

And when it comes to the release date? It'll be ready when we know it's ready. We'll keep you in the know every step of the way.

[*] Fixed an issue that sometimes caused characters to be put on bottoms when wearing a dress that covers top and bottom.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 1.3.2.12219d
notes.notes:
Small patch to improve save/load function. 

This patch is a potential fix for corrupted save files (empty house) being generated sometimes for some players.  We haven't been able to reproduce the issue in our testing environment, but we have been analyzing our code closely to identify what could be causing the issue.  This patch will not fix save files that have already been corrupted, but it we hope it will prevent the creation of corrupted save files going forward.  This patch may also improve performance of some older saves (pre 1.3.0), although saves from 1.3.0 forward are still recommended for the best experience with the new system.

notes.title: House Party Character Customization, HDRP Upgrade Out Now!
notes.notes:
We know you've all been waiting for it and it's finally here!  You can get the HDRP graphics engine upgrade and customization update now!

The longest ongoing house party in the history of the world just got better!

This new upgrade adds a TON of customizable options to your game and the game now looks better than ever before, rendered with High Definition Render Pipeline!

We made a new trailer featuring the new graphics and we've uploaded some new screenshots to our House Party store page as well!

[previewyoutube=C4JU2UEht6I;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]We've Switched to Unity's High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP):[/b][/u]

We're upgrading our engine to take advantage of HDRP's capabilities in Office Party, but we were also able to bring some HDRP enhancements to House Party too!  In House Party, you'll notice amazing new lighting and shadows as well as upgraded models and enhanced textures that can be seen in an overall visual upgrade to the house and all of the characters! 

[u][b]Character Customization:[/b][/u]

Take House Party to the next level and customize all of the characters in the game including the male and female player characters.  If you haven't seen it, also check out our character customization video:

[previewyoutube=6_nJXCrNhmg;full][/previewyoutube]

The video shows off the ability to change clothing colors, patterns, decals, and even add effects like emboss and metallic to some clothing pieces.  It also shows off the character options that include changing character skin tone, makeup, hair root and tip color, and inner and outer eye color.  Since we released the video, we've also added the option to customize nail color and other.. uh.. fun stuff.  There's also some clothing options that will be unlocked with achievements.  Speaking of which, for the achievement hunters, we've added 1 new achievement to the Liz Katz DLC and 1 new achievement to the original story!  Check out some example outfits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/67ea56a10181685363b10fd849ea98c1c3029e48.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/8bd4c9b196e19d5ec52cfa9dd4be83aa3e479c70.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/02519a0fdba021b11e9e0061fcfac140a1407949.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/02cfb76b992f6d163ba8d4b36076950e5c77e78f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/cfc84c66d99aa42ed8b5554eddca27ace8422c82.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/19da8cae8dde0e8e62334fc4784597e57ee854a7.png[/img]

[u][b]Engine and game upgrades:[/b][/u]

On top of all of that, we've added a bunch of cool new features, including:

WAY faster saving and loading times
A spiffy new loading screen
All characters can now have sweat/wet effects and clothing can have blood effects
A new cutscene for a Liz Katz DLC freezer event, and a cutscene when the player reaches over a railing in the Original Story

This update has taken us a bit to pull together, possibly longer than any other update in the past, but the result is a refreshing new House Party feel that makes the game feel like a whole new game!  

And last but not least, we finally changed the song that plays over and over again on loop!  Just kidding.  We would never do that.  Enjoy the game!

[b]Happy Holidays![/b]

[b]We can't wait to see what kinds of customizations you all come up with![/b]

We'd love to see your designs in our [url=https://discord.gg/eekgames]discord[/url]!

NOTE: Because of the new super fast save/load system, old save files will not be compatible with the new version, but you will be able to play old saves by rolling back to the 1.2.2.1 version of the game by switching to that beta branch on Steam.

P.S.  We will have official sharing support coming for the customization presets soon.  In the meantime, if you really want to share a creation with a friend, you can by copying the files in your Documents\Eek\House Party\Customization\ folder and having your friend drop the files in their respective folders.

notes.title: Clothing Customization, HDRP, Engine Optimization Coming Soon to House Party!
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

A huge thanks to all of you who have been enjoying the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1524910/House_Party__Detective_Liz_Katz_in_a_Gritty_Kitty_Murder_Mystery_Expansion_Pack/]Liz Katz Gritty Kitty Murder Mystery DLC[/url].  The feedback has been very positive, and we are happy to have brought another chapter of House Party to you.

We know a lot of you are wondering what comes next, and although we are still working on one more DLC for House Party, we've been starting to [b]shift our focus to Office Party as well![/b]

We are optimizing and adding new capabilities to our engine to create a more robust foundation heading into Office Party.  This will help improve the game performance and allow for new features that Office Party will have, that House Party doesn’t.  A big one of those things is clothing customization!

Just because we are transitioning into working on the Office Party engine doesn’t mean that House Party can’t reap the benefits of some of the upgrades and optimizations that we are doing.  [b]In the next  release of the House Party[/b] base game we will be leveraging the groundwork we’ve been laying down for Office Party, to [b]optimize House Party’s performance, and bring some new features to the mix this summer.[/b]


[u][b]Character Customization:[/b][/u]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/f8ec58e5b3840e804b034dcd04a7eb1327228890.png[/img]

The most exciting new feature that you'll see is character customization!  You'll be able to change colors, patterns, decals (on some characters), skin tone, hair root and tip color, and even add effects like emboss and metallic to some clothing pieces.  Check out more example outfits:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/bd8ccc141c543868fce361c721f9617034393146.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/558193a98033a6b40ac69dc9c2a6a33f5daaf4e4.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/e93b06117ae4cf8740a6c47a0d82c73fd44ea536.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/3836d138e2771ab0ba2d769c9ca4c8f37f9a7050.png[/img]


[u][b]We're Switching to Unity's High Definition Render Pipeline (HDRP):[/b][/u]

notes.title: The Free House Party - Winter Holiday Pack Is Out Now!
notes.notes:
Winter is here, brahs!

Download the completely free [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2229631/House_Party__Winter_Holiday_Pack/?curator_clanid=43270569][b]House Party - Winter Holiday Pack[/b][/url] to keep your party merry and bright all year long!

Party in a festive, Christmas-themed version of Madison's house full of holiday cheer - with snowflakes falling outside, opportunities for snowball-throwing, a hysterical new short Frank side-story quest, and your favorite party-goers bundled up in themed Santa, elf, and reindeer hats and ugly sweaters!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/72f6fb7649ab9dfea352a9fe621c6f5e665c4961.png[/img]

Much like the House Party - Halloween Holiday Pack, the House Party - Winter Holiday Pack is a permanent, year-round version of the limited-time 2022 seasonal winter update.

Unlike the haunting vibes from the Halloween DLC, the Winter DLC introduces pine garlands, hanging lights, glowing candy canes, star-shaped lights, ornaments, a snowman, and snowflake window decals to the party space. 

There's plenty to explore with the return of this fun-filled holiday. Armed with a bucket of snowballs at your side, get ready to pelt your favorite NPCs with snowballs to see their hysterical reactions and collect Frank's special holiday steam achievement in his funny seasonal side quest!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/b1e6b17af88ef1bf84838aeb2d898619817e282c.png[/img]

Thank you for waiting while our team worked hard to get this event permanently prepared for you! 

If you missed our post on the [b]House Party - Halloween Holiday Pack[/b], we explained that we hadn't expected either of these seasonal events to be so loved by players. But, many of you requested for us to keep them around permanently, and we wanted to do that for you!

Since these events weren't originally built to be in the game full dash time, we had to essentially completely rebuild both of them so they could be in the game permanently. 

We didn't want to compromise our normal development, so we tried to keep up our original planned pace and prepare these two seasonal DLCs alongside our original plans. Of course, this took a bit longer than we expected, and these events have permanently dropped at an odd time of the year, but we hope you're happy to finally see them back for good!

What did the full restructuring of these two seasonal DLCs include?
The DLCs are optional and won't bloat your base game if you never plan to play or install them
You can toggle on and off the DLCs if you ever don't feel like playing the Halloween or Winter content
We insured that merging the DLCs with house party wouldn't create any major bugs or issues that would impact the short or long-term health of the base game
And, most exciting, we future-proofed the DLC so more content can be added in future updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/1cb5eee218cdab0fe5fc693d386a504894429b22.png[/img]

As we mentioned with the House Party - Halloween Holiday Pack, you won't see any gameplay or content changes or new cosmetics in this DLC yet, but we have plenty more planned to come in the future.

We've also laid down a framework while restructuring both of these DLCs that will allow us to add a brand new free feature for all players. It is super exciting, and something many of you requested in our Future Of House Party Feedback Form. We can't wait to share it with you! 

And, speaking of, now that both of these awesome seasonal DLCs are finally released, we have so much on the horizon. 

The release of the [b]House Party - Detective Liz Catz in a Gritty Kitty Murder Mystery Expansion Pack[/b] is right around the corner, there are exciting new updates feature updates coming in our roadmap, and, toward the end of the year, we plan to release the [b]House Party - New Content Pack[/b], featuring two new characters from the House Party Universe!

For now, just look forward to everything cool that's on the way, and enjoy the winter-themed party!

Halloween is back, partiers!

Enjoy chilling at a decked-out house party filled with spine-chilling ambience, sinister costumes, and much more in this petrifying autumn party pack! 

[previewyoutube=fGxla8c8G0k;full][/previewyoutube]

Here by popular demand, the House Party - Halloween Holiday Pack is a permanent version of the limited-time 2022 seasonal Halloween update.

This DLC brings pumpkins, spooky ghosts, a skeleton, tons of spider webs, and one giant furry spider back to decorate Madison's house in creepy fall vibes! 

It also dresses all of the NPCs at the party in a chilling succubus costume - including startling horns, creepy bat wings, and a sexy, spiky tail!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/d644aabb095809222618e58cca03f49980fa4050.png[/img]

Thanks for your patience as we worked to get this ready, doods! 

We know it’s taken a while, but we hadn’t originally planned for the 2022 limited-time event to become permanent. It was a spur-of-the-moment idea fueled by season-induced passion, and it really wasn’t built to be in the game year-round.

However, after seeing so many of you ask for it to stay around, our team worked alongside our already-planned development schedule to completely rebuild the Halloween and Winter events so they’d be suitable to be in House Party permanently.

This full restructuring includes:
[list]
[*] Making it so the DLCs are optional and won’t bloat the base game if you never plan to play or install them
[*] Allowing you to toggle the DLC on and off if you don’t feel like enjoying the Halloween aesthetic during a specific play session
[*] Ensuring merging the content with House Party wouldn’t cause any major bugs or issues with the short or long-term health of the base game
[*] And, best of all, future-proofing the DLC so we can add more exciting content in additional updates! 🤘
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/1c5c21bb76691776084ff6a6810a35ba46eee883.png[/img]

While the Halloween Holiday Pack will visually look the same as the event did in 2022 (so, no, don’t expect to see any “new” playable content or cosmetics yet), it’s undergone complete restructuring and there are major framework changes under the surface. And these changes will allow us to properly add extra content (cosmetics, decorations, side-quests, achievements, etc.) to the Halloween Holiday Pack in the future as time permits!

Also implemented into this framework beneath the holiday pack are the roots of a very exciting new feature that we plan to bring for free to all players in the future. We won’t spoil exactly what this is yet, but we’ll just say it’s something MANY of you requested in the latest survey we released! 

So, get excited, doods and lady-doods, because what’s coming is gonna be amazing - and we can’t wait to share more details as we get further along in development. 

And, if you’re still waiting for the snowy season to return, don’t worry! The House Party - Winter Holiday Pack will be ready to play very soon, too! 

But, in the meantime, what are you waiting for? Come enjoy the haunted house party!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2229630/House_Party__Halloween_Holiday_Pack/]The House Party - Halloween Holiday Pack[/url] will be the first of our seasonal holiday packs to release, and we should have it ready to play within the next few weeks! 👻

While we haven’t shared too much about this yet, we’re planning to release some awesome new free feature updates for the base game - implementing some of the feedback we got from you brahs in our Future Of House Party Feedback Form! 🎉

It’ll include a cool new side story (separate from the original story), two brand new characters to interact with (one female, one male), and a couple new clothing items! 🔥

The theme of this DLC and much of the story inspiration will be drawn directly from your responses in the Future of House Party Feedback Form! We’re still in the conceptualization phase on this, so this means that we’ll announce what the winning clothing and story themes are for the DLC as soon as we can! 🍻

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/581afa746e59e82d1348ebc65ffefa42213103d4.png[/img]

[b]What about the future? And Office Party?[/b]

As shown in the timeline, the estimates for when some of these things will launch depends a lot on Office Party (House Party's sequel). 

While near-future releases are less likely to change, the stuff shown further out on our timeline could be shifted, delayed, or removed for the sake of working more on Office Party sooner. That’s why we avoided putting exact dates on the image itself. 

Where are we at with developing Office Party? Right now, we’re still planning, concepting, and laying out the early framework for it in the background, though it will be a while before we share anything new. But Office Party is coming, brahs, and it's gonna be awesome! 😱

And what about VR? Although we don’t have any new updates for you right now, we still plan to add it in the future! Anyway, that’s all for now, partiers. We hope you're excited to see what the rest of 2023 has in store for House Party! 🙌

House Party Version 1.0.9 is out now! If you like getting creative with House Party, you'll love the Custom Story Creator changes we made, doods and lady-doods.

Have you ever dreamed of making a party where everyone gets turned on as soon as you take off your shirt? Or where the whole party gangs up on Patrick? Or where all the guests meet up in the living room for a sweet no-pants-allowed dance party?

Yeah. Us too! That’s why we made it way, way easier to create those kinds of stories and much more with an awesome new feature called "CharacterGroup" behaviors. These let you work faster and more effectively to create more complex stories than ever before.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/092eddaa9294573bcfec17a8c0fafd283763b437.png[/img]

How does it work? You can now create targeted groups of Characters and use GameEvent, Criteria, Event Trigger, and/or CriteriaGroup behaviors on them selectively or en masse. Not all GameEvents and Criteria are available for use with this system, but this should be super cool nonetheless!

If you've worked with the Custom Story Creator before, you’ll understand the relief and creative potential now that you no longer have to send one-on-one instructions to them. This is huge, dudes!

Character groups should allow there to be more varied custom stories made by both new and experienced creators alike. We're stoked to see how you guys use this sweet new story-crafting superpower.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/41b51ecbaaccca7f0bc56c957b19a4224b7143bf.png[/img]

Several previous issues regarding past updates breaking custom stories have also been fixed, so your current stories should work as intended again! We've made significant optimizations that will notably reduce the UI "lag" experienced when manipulating many CSC elements, dropdowns, text fields, and so on, too.

([i]Note: The new optimizations required minor changes to the CSC UI. Some functionalities like sorting/arranging elements are now controlled strictly through user-interactable elements like arrows, the copy/paste functions, and insert/remove.[/i])

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/e6fd589dc82a600d1ed5184070d132029e6030cb.png[/img]

Update 1.0.9 also irons out some bugs (some of which were not just minor annoyances), adds some story and engine improvements, and includes a fresh new Spanish translation!

We've continued making progress on the user interface and functionality for selecting a holiday DLC pack, too. We still have more mechanics to work on before we can tie DLCs into the engine and bundle the Winter and Halloween holidays into individual downloadable packs, but we're making good progress!

Plus, we added those two new objects around the party that will be used in our next guest expansion pack! If you want a sneak peek at what’s to come, explore the house and let us know what you think the new fixtures will be used for!

Have fun playing, party brahs! We can't wait to see your custom stories.

[i]P.S. Want an example of the fun and silly stories you can create with House Party’s Custom Story Creator? Check out this quick video taken from Peter980’s “Fiery Date” story! To learn more about the story or hang out for our House Party dev streams, join our Discord![/i]

notes.title: The Winter Update is Live!
notes.notes:
This winter, there are plenty of exciting new decorations around the house! You'll find pine garlands, hanging lights, glowing candy canes, star-shaped lights, ornaments, a snowman, and snowflake window decals all around Madison's house.

The partygoers are dressed with holiday spirit, too; several of House Party's characters are wearing Santa hats, elf hats, and even a festive sweater! 

In this cheery update, it will be snowing lightly outside, you'll be able to throw snowballs at other party guests, and Frank will be getting into the spirit of the holidays in a short new themed side-quest! It's a little bigger than our Halloween update was, so we hope you enjoy it!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/afdade2d72003932068c00faacf182155e7eb0ca.png[/img]

Will the winter holiday update be a limited-time update like Halloween? Yes and no. 

For now, the winter event will be a temporary base game patch. However, because we received such a positive response to our Halloween update, a permanent DLC version of both events will drop sometime early next year - and will be completely free to play! Halloween will be ready first and Winter will follow sometime after that.

Even better, they will also include a much-requested toggle on/off feature, so you will be able to activate or deactivate the seasonal content without uninstalling and reinstalling it! 
Keep an eye out, because we'll be making them wishlistable fairly soon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/21410d974df113b9864d5749fee507522b097aa2.png[/img]

Just so everyone is aware, we are going to hold off on doing more holiday events in the short term after these ones (but more are still coming). So, while you probably won't see new events for the first half of next year, we are planning new content for Halloween and Winter in late 2023 and will introduce more exciting new holidays beyond that point!

The reason for this is we do need to take some time in early 2023 to work on finalizing the toggle on/off feature, packaging these events into permanent playable DLCs for you, and not get too distracted from focusing on other development that we need to do for the game (like our next mystery guest, VR, and planning Office Party). The holidays are amazing, but they have taken a bit more time than we expected from overall game development, so we do need to slow that timeline a bit!

Also, in the sake of transparency, we wanted to be up-front that things were going really well with PlayStation, but they drastically changed their stance and flipped to to a more Twitch-like position recently…but we’re used to this by now, and we are still discussing content guidelines with them and comparing those guidelines to what’s already on their store with what’s in our game. We have hope they'll come around and work with us on bringing House Party to console. We'll continue to keep you updated on this as time goes on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/5212ce9df4312deef959008cc129577e15642c54.png[/img]

Anyway, we have had so much fun doing these seasonal events so far, and we can't wait to expand on them more for you (and add new holidays to the mix)! You've given us amazing feedback to use for our 2023 Halloween and Winter Holiday updates, and now we're going to sit down as a team and plan the best way for us to incorporate this feedback alongside the rest of our development pipeline moving forward! 

The winter update is live now...so what are you waiting for? Go play it, partiers! The event will be available to play until January 9th! Deck the balls, doods!

[i]P.S. If you complete the new holiday achievement during the update, you will not have to redo it again when the winter content is a permanent DLC to get 100% completion. However, if you are not around to play during the winter update and you miss the achievement, the achievement will be on the Steam list but unable to complete until the House Party - Winter Holiday Pack is released permanently in Q1 2023.

P.P.S. If you're not feeling the holiday spirit and don't want to play the winter content, don't forget that you can swap back to the regular base game version of the game at any time! To do this, just go to the Steam beta branch and select the previous game version!
[/i]

notes.title: Weekly News: Winter Update, Community Feedback and more!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/7aacf9a7a7be84697b4254ec6c14b426267c2829.png[/img]

Happy December, doods and lady-doods! The holidays are almost here, and we’ve got some fun news to share about our upcoming winter seasonal update! 

Before we get into the details, we just want to give a quick heads-up that we are still working on that Toggle On/Off feature for holiday content that we promised. Although it won’t be ready in time for our winter event, we hope to have it ready for beta testing early next year!

With that said, when it drops, the Winter Event will be a temporary update to the base game (without the toggle feature), but we will release it as a permanent free DLC (just like we’ll be doing with Halloween) with a toggle on/off feature as soon as it's ready after the holiday.

Thanks for being patient with us, doods! We want to make sure this feature is good to go and package the DLCs properly going forward. We definitely focused on getting the content out on time for the holidays first, and are stoked you’re enjoying it enough to make it permanent!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/d032cad03b15d90d1a3f156e74e49fa83a528df8.png[/img]

So, what can you look forward to in the winter event?

Thanks to an overwhelming amount of you asking for Seasonal-Themed Opportunities / Short Side Stories, we are planning to release a little holiday Quest that features its own special Steam Achievement!

We also heard you about Seasonal Activities and added a new in-game activity (we'll give you a clue...it has to do with that bucket of snowballs we shared last week).

A bunch of you also asked to see Frank as Santa. Like...a weird amount of you brahs have a kink for seeing the angriest, most aggressive, most domineering dude at the party dressed as the most cheerful, heartwarming, generous man of the season for some reason. Full-body custom outfits take a lot of our artists’ time, so no promises on a full Santa costume (this year), but let's just say Frank will definitely get into the spirit of the holidays!

Speaking of making things happen - but a bit off-topic to the holiday content - did you know in our last update (Stable Release 1.0.6), we also brought back the mechanic where painkillers give a stamina boost and booze (beer, wine, liquor) gives a strength boost? 

We had to remove that feature to get House Party ESRB "Mature" rated (you know, so we could get on various platforms that are still giving us a hard time), but it's back in the Explicit Add-On since you guys asked for it on our last dev stream! Enjoy drinking your way to buffness, doods!

notes.title: Weekly News: Halloween Party Update, QOL and more!
notes.notes:
Been enjoying the Halloween Party, brahs? We’re stoked so many of you have checked it out and enjoyed the seasonal decorations and costumes!

We’ve been hearing that many of you like the event so much that you’d love to be able to keep using the Halloween assets even though the spooky season will be over soon. So, we plan to add the ability for players to toggle them on or off from the main menu. Although we can’t give an exact date on when this will be added to the game, this is definitely something we are working on implementing - stay tuned for more updates!

The Halloween event was a spur-of-the-moment decision for us, but we felt it was content worth sharing with all you doods! Supporting seasonal content has been something we’ve always wanted to do, but our focus on getting House Party out of Early Access kept us from being able to. Now that the game’s released, we have a ton of additional awesome content that we want to bring as free updates for everyone going forward!

 While we’re definitely down to do more seasonal events, these won’t happen every holiday, since we don’t want to slow down development on full-fledged DLCs and Office Party. However, we’ll try our best to add them whenever we can.

We’ll also be looking into allowing you access to events once they’re over! One potential idea we’re heavily considering is creating a free seasonal DLC for our holiday event, like a Halloween DLC, and updating it with new content every Halloween!

This will allow players who want to skip the seasonal content to do so, while still giving them the option to download it at a later time! Those who have the free Halloween DLC in their libraries will be able to toggle the event content on and off in the House Party main menu at their leisure!

We hope this sounds exciting to everyone! Since the event has been so popular, we’ll keep it rolling for another week. After that, the Halloween content will briefly go away (for now), but, don’t worry, you’ll see the content again in the future once we implement the toggle feature and create the DLC!

If you’re curious how our development progress is coming along on the base game, we’re making good headway on the quality of life update we mentioned in our previous Steam roadmap post. 

None of this is live quite yet, but the upcoming update will include some UI updates for the base game, and, if you have the Explicit Content Add-On installed, you’ll be able to access POV legacy intimacy for the female content and the new intimacy sequences and poses that are arriving very soon!

Thanks again for chilling with us this Halloween! We hope you had a spooky time and are excited for our next update!

notes.title: Weekly News: QoL Updates, PS Release, VR DLC, mystery guest DLC and more!
notes.notes:
How’s it going, partiers? Cheers to everyone who saw last week’s teaser and already guessed the identity of House Party’s next mystery guest. We figured anyone who saw the picture who was already familiar with them would recognize who it was almost instantly - that tattoo is iconic! 

We’re excited to share more details on this awesome guest soon, and we’ll also drop an updated roadmap with tentative release dates in the future! But, in the meantime, here’s some info to keep everyone in the loop about what’s next for House Party.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/5942bd06e24a25f74ab8e968675171a0ab5b6350.png[/img]

[b]House Party’s Next Mystery Guest DLC[/b]

Since we’ve officially solidified our partnership with House Party’s next mystery guest, we’ll be moving forward with planning their storyline very soon. There’s a bunch of work to be done, but our mystery guest is stoked to join House Party, and we couldn’t be more excited to start working with them to create their DLC!

[b]Quality of Life Updates[/b]

When House Party released from Early Access, we promised more base game quality-of-life updates, and we don’t plan on stopping anytime soon! Our team is constantly working on fixing bugs, fine-tuning gameplay, and optimizing your party experience - and we appreciate everyone who has helped us so far by reporting bugs on our Discord server!

But, what’s more exciting is that, in addition to tweaking the overall game, we plan on doing some small continuity updates down the road for the female player character which will add new minor content and story changes so the female playthrough experience will feel even smoother!

Specifically, in our next quality-of-life update (which we're working on right now), we have some UI tweaks and POV legacy intimacy system updates on the way. Explicit content owners will now be able to access POV legacy intimacy for the new female content and new sequences and poses will be coming soon!

[b]PlayStation[/b]

If you follow us on social media, you’ve probably seen that we’ve been looking into porting House Party to PlayStation. We’re glad to announce that those plans are finally solidifying, and we’ll be taking some more concrete steps to bring the party to console!

A few of you have also asked about the availability of explicit, adult-only intimacy content on the console version, and we want to be as transparent as possible about this. While we always try our best to push the boundaries of content as much as we can with our game, we do need to take care to adjust our content to align with what is allowed on specific platforms.

[b]Virtual Reality[/b]

Who hasn’t fantasized about playing House Party in VR? We are hard at work bringing the party into virtual reality (we wonder if Rachael will know), and just recently took some big initial steps to make this possible. There’s a lot of work involved with this process, but we can’t wait to share more updates on the VR version of House Party soon!

[b]House Party’s Sequel: Office Party[/b]

We haven’t forgotten about House Party’s sequel game, Office Party, either! Alongside everything else keeping our dev team crazy busy, we're also slowly planning, conceptualizing, and laying out the framework for our next game. We can’t wait to share more with everyone!

[b]House Party Clothing DLCs[/b]

Last but definitely not least, we haven’t forgotten about all of the community requests we’ve gotten asking for us to add ways for players to customize the appearances of the base game NPCs. We’ve had a number of people asking if we can create different optional Clothing DLCs for the OG House Party characters, and the answer is yeah, brahs, we’d love to do that!

If you have any ideas for outfits you’d like to see in House Party, we’d really appreciate your feedback. Comment below and let us know!

notes.notes:
The real-life Grammy and American Music Award-winning star arrive at the House Party in style!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/b39ac3620c080f8c4dddb42b240e206be569d886.png[/img]

She brings an amazingly realistic in-game character and wild new gameplay to the Original Story! Explore a hysterical new branching adventure in your favorite comedy game and help Doja Cat create her next music video - for better or worse!

There's a major celebrity joining the House Party! We've teamed up with the hit pop star Doja Cat to deliver a wild all-new side-story to the party that's packed with unforgettable adventure, comedy, and mystery!

In the DLC, you can navigate through an unpredictable night filled with outrageous partygoers as they help Doja Cat carry out a master plan to track down a mysterious masked dancing sensation taking the online world by storm.

You'll also be able to see her in-game wearing three outfits that were hand-selected by Doja herself; a casual black dress, awesome music video performance attire, and a steamy hot tub bikini.

Throughout her story, Doja will react to the craziness that ensues during the party, showcase custom dances and performances, and create her next music video with your assistance - and how it turns out depends entirely on your in-game choices!

notes.title: House Party 1.0.1 Stable Release
notes.notes:
[b]After-Party Bug Fixes & Performance Updates Arrive In House Party Stable Release 1.0.1![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/035557f65ca40640c9ad5571f96dc25e079aeb06.png[/img]

The exciting post-release after-party is here, doods and lady-doods!

If you've been watching our updates lately, you know that the Doja Cat DLC is coming along awesomely, and we're still working super hard on improving the base game, too! Also, we're proud to announce that House Party's Stable Release 1.0.1 is available to all players now!

What's in this fancy new release? Well, before House Party left Early Access, we added some of the biggest graphical improvements that the party had seen thus far, and we also added some pretty graphically intense cutscenes. In this update, we worked hard to account for these graphical upgrades by adding a ton of optimization improvements!

We have also significantly reduced the memory that House Party uses, increased the frame rate of the game, improved frame drop and game lag issues in the yard (which were reported by multiple partiers), and fixed several crashing and stability problems. The game should be a much smoother and consistent experience for everyone going forward!

Thanks to these changes, House Party also runs smoother on the Steam Deck! You should find that the game now plays great on Ultra settings.

Of course, a handful of bug fixes and other changes to existing content were added in this update, too! It should be much harder for characters to accidentally fall outside the game world (total party foul right?), new translation components were added to the "hard coded" English text so translators can make more progress on localization, and we improved some sight check/culling check settings.

You can also now grab more items around the house, and keen-eyed players might spot a few mysterious, spoilery items hanging out and about in the game world!

Want to see a full list of the changes? Read our patch notes below.

-Eek! Team

- We reworked The Muse (storyline for Madison and Derek), the Sibling Warfare (storyline for Ashley), and Vickie’s endurance test to better fit the female player.

- Not only can you now bond with Derek, but we made it so the female player can now ask him for help and advice on a variety of topics. He’s not your long-time buddy anymore, but he’s still happy to help you find your way around the party!
- We added and adjusted LOADS of dialogue and responses for a bunch of characters to smooth out gameplay for the female player across the entire Original Story. The characters most affected by these changes are Brittney, Derek, Madison, Rachael, and Vickie, but almost every character has something new for you to discover!!
- We updated almost all of the romance scenes in the game to work with the female player, including dialogue and context, and redesigned much of the hookup logic to provide a more fulfilling experience for her. We plan on polishing the romance scenes even further and will add new cutscenes in our first update after the Doja Cat DLC launches!
- We made it so the female player can now ask Brittney to move to another location, provided that the player has done something to help her out first. Are you a good enough friend to help Brittney mingle?
- We updated poses so male poses in the Original Story are now replaced by female poses whenever appropriate.
...and much more! 

These changes aren't live yet, but we're excited to bring them live in our upcoming update when we officially leave Early Access next week. We hope you’ll have fun exploring the new content when it drops!

notes.title: Happy Pride Month, Dev Update, and Female Player ETA
notes.notes:
[b]Happy Pride Month, partiers! [/b]

In our last few major story updates, we’ve had the opportunity to add a bunch of really cool LGBTQ+ content to the game.

Back when we were a one-man dev team, adding stuff like the Frank and Derek stories, the Vickie threesome cutscenes, and the full female playthrough would never have been possible, but we’re really happy now to have an amazing team that has made adding gay, bisexual, and lesbian content to House Party possible.

Thanks a bunch for supporting us, and we’re really excited to see what’s in store for House Party’s future DLC content and Office Party! We hope everyone has an awesome pride month!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29297549/9c357a1eb4695bea58d57aaca71dd00948578c00.png[/img]

[b]Female Player First Look, Bug Fixes, and Progress Update[/b]

In our female player first look, we shared the framework for the female player, which included a thorough first pass through the existing male content and a bunch of tone, pronoun, and wording tweaks to make you feel at home in the party as the female player. 

The next update will finalize a lot of the female player’s content, include some unique story for the female player, and it will fix a bunch of bugs that everyone reported during playtesting!

We can’t share too many details about the female’s unique story content yet, but we can list a few of the bugs we fixed that you’ve been asking about! Here’s our best attempt at trying to make just a small portion of our internal patch notes Steam appropriate:

[list]
[*] We fixed a bug that allowed the female player to trigger reactions from NPCs as if they’d been “ejected” on.
[*] Inside intimacy cutscenes, NPCs will now have a sensitivity of 1 in the base game. This will help prevent premature and doubled up “happy times” in cutscenes where an NPC and another character are close enough to get turned on via proximity.
[*] We fixed an issue that allowed characters to repeatedly step backwards instead of walking to a target.
[*] We fixed a problem that could cause cutscenes to occasionally become erroneously paused immediately after they had started.
[*] Users can now save a game manually without inputting a custom save game name (this will use a date and playtime-based timestamp).
[*] We fixed a problem that could cause noticeable camera sway when the female player was in a certain pleasure-giving pose (pose 10). 
[*] We fixed an issue that caused extremely unpleasant camera twitching when the female player was receiving certain pleasure acts.
[/list]

We hope these changes make your experience playing House Party smoother and more enjoyable. Keep in mind that these bug fixes are not live yet, but they will be coming in our next update!

[b]But…Eek! Team, when IS the Female Player going live?[/b]

We don’t have an official date right now, but we shared in our AMA with the Eek! Games founders that House Party will leave Early Access in July, and we plan to have her base story completed by then!

We’ve had a ton of stuff going on with the lead-up to launch, and we really appreciate how patient everyone has been. This is a seriously exciting time for the game, and, between the female story and the Doja Cat DLC, we have a ton of really awesome stuff to share with everyone in these next few months!

notes.title: House Party Update (0.22.0) Female Player First Look & Full Controller Support!
notes.notes:
[h2]The female player's first look is here, doods! [/h2]

Although we haven't prepared new Original Story content for her quite yet, you can now play as a female character (on the Steam testing branch, more below)! We've done a thorough first pass through the existing content and made a bunch of tone, pronoun, and wording tweaks to make you feel at home in the party as the female player! Unfortunately, we have not had the time to get voiced lines for much of this alternate content or fully convert all intimacy sequences, but bear with us! We’re working on it!

Since adding her is a huge task, this update will be a little different than what you're used to. We'll be splitting this update into two pieces: A live update for all users with fully functional controller support and quality of life fixes and a testing update containing controller support, quality of life fixes, and the female character first look.

This will give Steam players the opportunity to experiment with the female player and give us feedback as we work through adding more of her content! This also means that your game will automatically update to the version with controller support, but you will need to opt in to the Steam Testing Update if you would like to try the version with the female player first look.

We decided to do the update this way because we didn't want the female character to be unplayable the entire time we worked on her (since we'll probably be working on her until around the time we exit Early Access). Releasing the female player first look as a Steam Testing Update and gradually updating it from there will allow a big chunk of players to try her early and give us feedback as we work on bringing her full content into the game!

Controller support is also fully functional, and we added some general House Party polish and UI improvements to this update. You can play the game without any major hang-ups on all supported controllers and the Steam Deck. We still plan on adding some quality of life features and fixes in the future to fine-tune how everything feels, but, as it is now, it's completely playable. 

If you're curious about the polish we added, some notable changes are that we adjusted the colors for most of the interactable UI elements so they're easier to see and fixed some cutscene issues that could cause them to get stuck. We also added a garage cutscene and a Frank mini oral scene in the yard.

Leading up to our release from Early Access later this year, we'll be adding some quality of life features to controller support, polishing and bug fixing the hell out of the base game, and adding a lot more Original Story content, voice acting, and intimacy-specific tweaks and fixes for the female player.

Thanks for being the coolest partiers ever and staying patient as we worked through the hurdle of uncensoring Lety's content in our last update. We're sorry for the delay, and we hope you have fun playing as a female! We're excited to add more of her story as we get closer to House Party's exit from Early Access!

Ready to try out the new update? Right-click House Party in your Steam Library, navigate to the “Betas” tab, use the drop-down menu to select the "Testing" option, and hit "Close!" You're all set! Be sure to report any bugs you find in the female player first look, and let us know if there are more quality of life fixes you'd like to see added to controller support. Enjoy the update, doods!

- Eek! Team

Patch Notes: https://housepartygame.com/release-notes

Note: Updates labelled as “Testing”, “Beta”, and/or “First Look” contain unfinished and untested content. Placeholders may be present for dialogue and various assets. Older save files may no longer be compatible. Custom stories may no longer function as intended. Translations may also be incomplete. Controller support is nearly finished, but if you do run into issues, you may need to temporarily use your keyboard/mouse to restore normal functionality.

notes.title: Lety is Now Completely Uncensored In The 0.21.2 Mini Stable Release Update!
notes.notes:
What's up, totally cool-muy bueno-fellow party persons? We just wrapped up House Party version 0.21.2, which is a fairly small but much-needed maintenance update that brings the party closer to our ultimate goal of being...dope sickness...on fleek...lit…

Alright, we'll keep it together and give you a quick rundown: We're making good progress toward getting full controller support and an initial version of the female player beta ready for you guys to check out in our next big stable release, so it won't be much longer until you can officially play as House Party's female protagonist! We know you're stoked to test the waters of muy caliente girl-on-girl love gameplay, so we're working hard to get her into the party as soon as possible!

Speaking of hotness at the party, you may have realized your favorite sultry Spanish teacher has been looking a little...well, covered in black bars for the last couple of updates. Unfortunately, Steam updated the rules policy regarding depicting real people in video games, which raised some concerns about Lety's content. To stay on the safe side and not risk having the game or any major part of it completely removed, we were forced to censor her for a short time while we got everything figured out and learned more about the new rules.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/W4jsidF.gif[/img]

If you've read House Party's title screen or any of our interviews, you already know we're not fans of censorship. We weren't happy to censor Lety's content all of the sudden on you guys, so we prioritized getting this fixed as soon as we could. Thankfully, we were able to discuss the content directly with Steam's team and made adjustments to get Lety uncensored again! In this update, she's no longer restricted by those ugly black bars so, as long as you own the Explicit Content DLC, you can now see her again in all of her sexy cool kid extraordinaire glory with this update!

We also have some bonus good news on the anti-censorship side of things. Before this update, we had to censor everything body-wise, at all times, in the non-explicit version of the game. However, in this update, we'll no longer have upper body mosaic censors on characters regardless of explicit DLC ownership or installation. This is a huge win for House Party!

We hope you're looking forward to these changes and thanks for being patient while we fixed this, dudes. We know it was probably shocking and frustrating to have her content unexpectedly blacked out, and we weren't expecting the rules to change on us like that. As a mature game we always have to tread carefully with our content, and as a small development team we appreciate you guys allowing us extra time to get it fixed.

Anyway, onward to the next update! We're running a bit behind on our original timeline estimate, so we've gotta cruise. In the meantime, enjoy the maintenance changes and having your passionate times with Lety back to normal. Remember...no grabbing, guys, NO GRABBING!

notes.title: Lety Will Be Restored to Her Original Textures!
notes.notes:
Hey everybody!

As a lot of you already know, Steam recently changed their rules around real people being depicted in video games that they sell on their platform.  After reading about the changes, we took the liberty to make some changes to our Lety character in the game to bring her to a state where we felt she fell into compliance with these albeit vague new regulations.

We weren't sure whether or not Lety's character would be considered in violation of the new rules, but we didn't want to risk possibly having the game removed from Steam (been there, done that), especially as we are right on the verge of some amazing things happening like coming out of early access, the female player, and Doja Cat's arrival later this fall.  Our first order of action needed to be to react, and ask questions later, which is exactly what we did.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ShlT5NE.gif[/img]

We are always listening to our community though, and we heard your feedback loud and clear after we made the changes.  We took the issue up directly with Steam to get a clear answer, and that answer is that as long as we don't use real images or body scans, we are able to restore Lety's original textures in the Explicit Content patch.

That being said, and since Lety's textures are not real images or based on scans, we are excited to announce that in an upcoming update coming very soon, we will restore Lety's full textures to their original form and she will be completely uncensored if you have the Explicit Content DLC pack installed.

Thank you guys for your patience while we sorted this one out!

notes.title: House Party Early Access Steam Update
notes.notes:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/7e872a373fb80856f45fe583a088261063455833.png[/img]


After a long and incredible journey, we are getting ready to pull House Party out of Early Access!

After our stable build of the latest update goes live in the coming weeks, there will only be one more content update before we officially leave Early Access.  Vickie’s finale coming to a close marks the completion of all of the content we have planned for our male protagonist, and the next couple of updates are going to be mostly polish, alongside the long-awaited ability to play as a female main character.

We’re sure you have questions, but we have answers!  So strap in.  Here we go!

[b]When is House Party leaving Early Access?[/b]

We’re glad you asked!  Here’s our tentative timeline of what we currently have planned:

November 2021 – Vickie Finale Update
December 2021 – Polish Update and Full Controller Support
February 2022 – Female Playthrough First Public Look
March 2022 – Polish Update and Final Implementation of Female Playthrough
March 2022 – House Party Exits Early Access
May 2022 – Mystery Guest DLC

That said, we want to thank everyone who has purchased, played, and supported House Party throughout these years of development. We can’t stress enough how none of this would have been possible without you.  The biggest thing that kept us going through all of the journalist negativity and attempted censorship we’ve had to deal with over the years, was our overly positive player review scores and feedback.  Today, House Party has supportive press reviews, a steady player base, and is accepted in both censored and uncensored forms across various streaming platforms.  Additionally, if you’ve been paying any attention to our latest teasers, you’ll know that we’re about to take things to a whole other level, all thanks to your support, feedback and encouragement.  House Party’s graphics have been improved.  We’ve added globalization and translation.  We fleshed out the storyline and even added extra things we never planned for like the combat system, cutscenes and controller support.  We’ve taken your suggestions to heart throughout this whole process, and we’re always trying to make House Party the best it can be for all players.

[b]What’s going to change now that House Party is leaving Early Access?[/b]

Part of this process involved making changes to the game, the most significant of which, is that we now have a base game with a Steam “Mature” rating, and we have a Steam “Adult Only” rated DLC patch.  Initially, the DLC patch’s purpose was simply to uncensor any nudity or sexual content in the game, but since then a lot of the mature content has been moved from the base game to the Explicit DLC patch.  We are also now developing bigger, longer, and explicit cutscenes specifically for that content patch.

Because of this, and because we plan to add more content specifically to the Explicit DLC patch, we will soon be adding a small charge for the DLC patch.  We wanted to let you know ahead of time, since if you already own the game, you can still (at the time of this writing) download the patch for free, and if you downloaded it at any point while it is free, it will remain free permanently.  This price increase will only affect new players, and the base game price will remain unchanged even after we exit Early Access.

We will continue to maintain this optional AO rated patch as a counter to the changes the “powers that be” require us to make to allow the base game to maintain an “M” rating. It’s a necessary thing so that this game and our future games can continue to thrive both in and out of the mainstream, ensuring the stability of our company, which in turn means much more cool stuff to come down the line! House Party is all about choice, and we are committed to delivering the choice of adult content to our 18+ players, and to combat the regulations surrounding this type of content in video games as opposed to gratuitous violence, and exposing the hypocrisy and discrimination of creators of this type of content by the people who make these silly rules.

[b]What happens after House Party leaves Early Access?[/b]

Even though we’re ready to call the base game “finished”, this is only the beginning for House Party.  We have some wild stuff planned post release!  We will continue releasing “quality of life” updates after the game leaves Early Access, and we have plans for exciting DLC packs in the future to add more content to the game, and to give players more options.  We’ve already hinted at what the first one will be. Shortly after House Party’s full release and exit from Early Access, we will drop our first-ever DLC pack featuring the “mystery character” we’ve been teasing!  We think your minds will be blown when we drop our full reveal on that.  It’s coming soon!

Other than that, we will also be working on porting House Party to a VR version, as well as shifting more of our staff to working on our sequel game, Office Party.  Expect to see a lot more of Eek! Games in the future!

It’s an exciting time for us and we’re happy to be sharing it with all of you.  We’re so thankful you all have come on this development journey with us, and we’re stoked for everything in store for the future!

'Til next time!

-Eek Team

notes.title: New Playable Female Character and Early Access Exit Update
notes.notes:
We’ve noticed a lot of you have been asking about the details of the playable female character and how it ties in with us leaving Early Access. We have already made some strides toward implementation, and we thought since there was so much interest, we could share some [b]behind the scenes peeks[/b] and [b]information[/b] about where we’re at.

So first off, [b]we’ll just leave this small teaser here.[/b]

[previewyoutube=uqYllCbol5U;full][/previewyoutube]

Now that that’s out of the way, here’s a wall of text and some things to note for those of you hungry for more details :)

[b]1.[/b] The playable female character will [b]NOT[/b] be a DLC, and [b]WILL[/b] be included in the base House Party game.

[b]2.[/b] The female playable character and the new mystery guest we have planned for next year are [b]NOT [/b]the same thing. The mystery guest will be a new non-player character that can be added to the game via DLC after we exit Early Access. We’ll have more news on that later on.

[b]3. [/b]After our next update (Vickie Vixen’s end game content), which is estimated to be finished in the next few months, the playable female character will be our main priority, alongside full controller support, and various other tweaks and polish as we head toward exiting Early Access.

[b]4. [/b]The female playthrough will be similar to the male playthrough in many ways, but there will be new core game mechanics, and exclusive content that will only be available if playing as a female.

[b]5.[/b] We are aiming to get the playable female character out [b]BEFORE[/b] we leave Early Access, which is tentatively scheduled for March of 2022. We are working diligently to hit those goals, but of course as you know, things can spring up unexpectedly, and our main priority is putting out a great player experience first and foremost, so everything is potentially subject to change.

[b]6.[/b] Just because we are exiting Early Access doesn’t mean we are going to stop working on House Party. We feel that the game has come a long way and is finally in a state where the content will be finalized, but that doesn’t mean we won’t continue to polish it up or fix bugs or release quality of life updates in the future. We also have a lot of ideas of things to add to House Party, but we will be transitioning to doing so in the form of DLC after we leave Early Access, as the core game mechanics that we originally envisioned for the game have already been added, and we also added a bunch of stuff along the way that we never intended to originally, like combat, cutscenes, controller support, and localization to list a few.

[b]7.[/b] Our pricing may change as we transition to leave Early Access. Though this is pretty typical for most games, for us, it’s because we have a [b]LOT [/b]in the works for the future of House Party, and our studio in general, some of which we have just been starting to hint at. Things are evolving rather quickly, and some of you might be very surprised to see what we have in store for you. That being said, part of that process involves continually taking inventory of what we need and who we need to reach our goals, and as the scope of this project has changed over the years, so has our need to continually expand our team. We aren’t talking about any major changes to pricing here, but probably small tweaks and reassessment to make sure we can continue to bring new content to this game and future games consistently.

[b]We’re working hard on all of these things, and we appreciate all of your support and patience as we figure all this stuff out. We have more exciting announcements coming soon. Enjoy![/b]

notes.title: The End is in Sight, but it’s Only Just the Beginning…
notes.notes:
I know I haven’t done a dev blog update in a while, and it’s just because we’ve been so busy with the development of House Party, and because we’ve been working on a lot of cool stuff behind the scenes that we are finally able to start talking about.  I wanted to take a moment though and update you guys because we have exciting news!

[b][u][h3]House Party is slated to leave Early Access in March of 2022![/h3][/u][/b]

I know we’ve announced in the past that we were going to leave Early Access.  It’s definitely taken longer than expected, but we feel that all the extras we’ve added that we never originally intended to like globalization and translation, combat, controller support, a really cool new cutscene system, and more, were worth it.  This time though, we are finalized on content.  Or are we?  Actually, I did lie a little.  We have one more surprise.

On the day we leave Early Access we will be dropping a new DLC pack alongside it, which will allow you to invite a brand new very special guest to the party who… well let’s just say a lot of you may recognize.  That’s all I’m going to say for now, but rest assured, this is going to be huge!

House Party has come a long way since it’s inception, and I am so proud of the team I’ve assembled and the work we’ve done to take this game from a “best I could do” one man show to a top selling polished indie game.  I am also very happy we were able to persevere over the undue hardships that the media and the industry in general threw our way just because of our game themes and content, while letting the most violent and gruesome games thrive unchallenged.  We really hope that our accomplishments can change these weird taboos and help pave the way for other developers and games like House Party to be able to exist and receive fair treatment in the industry.

Lastly, I just want to thank everybody who’s purchased the game and supported us throughout our journey.  If it weren’t for all of you and the overwhelmingly positive player review scores that we can oh so eloquently shove in the face of the “game journalists” who loved to hate on us throughout the years, we wouldn’t be where we are today.  Part of the reason our journey out of Early Access has been a long one is because we listen to your feedback, and we have taken and implemented so many of your suggestions.  We do have to call it “finished” at some point though, and that point is near.  As of this writing, we are putting together the Vickie “finale” story, and then it’s full steam ahead on the female main character playthrough, all of which we are aiming to be launched when we transition out of Early Access.

Like I said though; this is just the beginning.  We will be releasing more “quality of life” updates for House Party after we fully transition from Early Access, and we also have some more surprise DLC packs planned down the road.  We have also already started laying down some of the groundwork for our sequel game “Office Party”.  Look for some amazing things happening very soon!

notes.title: Frank Update: A Stable 0.19.4 Update plus Turkish Translation
notes.notes:
Do you have the balls to handle the new update? Because the Frank 0.19.4 stable release is LIVE, dudes, and his 20 pound softball-sized crotch ornaments of pure muscle are the talk of the party! This is one of our largest updates (the game has grown over 20% since the last major update) and we promise the new gameplay is worth the junk-achingly long wait!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/96a48d5c89c93a319e16fecdfea6a460f454dd15.png[/img]

As you explore the party, you'll now hear background dialogue hinting at Frank's storyline. Make the right choices while chatting with Frank and you can explore his story - where feelings are shattered, naughty bits are revealed, and the party uncovers the true worth of a man's meat-danglers. The update adds a huge chunk of gameplay, a major branching ending, and five all-new Original Story Opportunities. Yes, one of those results in a deeper bond with Frank. How deep? ...That’s up to you, isn’t it? 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/9bc6e2961581256bcc89fb148a242b2373b428dc.jpg[/img]

You can now watch Derek shake his big booty on the dance floor by challenging him to a dance-off! The man's got serious moves, and you’ll need to find a creative solution to get past him to progress through Frank's story. Good thing there are helpful items and people at the party that can turn the tide in your favor!

There are two new ultra-secret items hidden around Madison's place that can assist you in winning Frank’s affection, too. We know you doods are professional scavenger hunters at this point, so happy hunting! And if you DO max out your Friendship with Frank...well, let’s just say he’ll be extra grateful to anyone who goes above and beyond!

BEEP, BOOP... Did we mention we made it so Compubrah can now scan Frank? Be sure to check out the wacky new gameplay, and enjoy the various stat-boosting benefits involved! 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/ddcbb92e2bd5934d6a2cb5046a2b19859bd33b7f.png[/img]

We nerfed Frank and Leah's alcohol-detecting spidey senses, too. You can drink a bit closer to them, but you still need to avoid their watchful gaze. Also, if you finish Frank's storyline and maintain being platonic BFFs, both he and Leah will be more forgiving of booze-related transgressions. Or, if you drive Frank out of the party completely, ALL alcohol-related actions will be forgiven throughout the playthrough!

If you don’t beat up Frank at the end of Leah’s “evil” route for “Broken Code”, there is now at least one meaningful reward for sparing him. Also, in Vickie’s “Training Day” content, choosing to practice your climax skills as part of her "Training Day" Opportunity now earns you bonuses to your intimacy recharge rate so you can get back to tumbling in the sheets sooner.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/a99bb309a42674eb2fd17450ae772e1238acfb8a.png[/img]

A new cutscene-style intimacy system is here, as well. Frank, Katherine, Rachael, and Vickie all have unique “finales” now. We also added a static cutscene for the Master Bedroom for other Characters that can perform or repeat their intimacy reward there. Don't miss this sweet new theater-style content! And, no worries, if you guys prefer the original POV intimacy system, it’s still available via a toggle option in the Main Menu.

We also optimized performance and spruced up the gameplay graphics. These include bug fixes, cleaner aesthetics, improvements to the “missed” Opportunities UI, adjustments to character models, and updates for the hot tub so it now looks AND sounds bubbly. And in addition to all new voice acting for Frank’s update, all missing VA from previous updates has been added, as well!

Autosaves and the explicit DLC are now reliably working again, and you can manually increase the in-game FOV to 75 by going to your Graphics Options, changing the value to 75, and hitting "Apply."

Our player community also got House Party fully translated into Turkish! Teşekkür ederim. You doods are the best! If you've been waiting to play the game in Turkish, now's your chance. 

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29297549/746d3a051291a77ef6e960d1ad2db578408f0b66.png[/img]

French is all set too, my brahs, but we're still waiting on other languages, the status of which we'll update you via Discord.

The party's now fully equipped with an all-new wonderful, dramatic, hilarious, and disgusting experience. The Frank experience. Enjoy, dudes.

- Eek Team
